name: Inventory shrinkage (theft + waste)
description: Customer theft, employee theft, mis-counted deliveries, expired-goods waste eroding margin.

name: Refund / return fraud
description: Customers (or staff) abuse return policies for cash refunds.

name: Food-safety incident / recall
description: Contamination, supplier-recall, cold-chain failure causing customer harm.

name: Supplier rebate / invoice fraud
description: Inflated supplier invoices, ghost rebates, kickback to buyer.

name: Imports from sanctioned jurisdiction
description: Goods sourced from a sanctioned origin or supplier.
